## ⭐ THE METHOD, AND THE TWO THINGS ADDED TO IT

**⭐ A DELIBERATE BREAK MUST BE SPECIFIC, NOT MERELY LOUD — AND THE FIRST ONE FOUND A HOLE
IN THE GATE ITSELF.** `zzclick`'s probes were all dispatched ON the element, so
`getTarget` always resolved and the entire coordinate path — `getCoord`,
`findElementByCoord`, the 12px radius, the four distance branches — **never ran**. Cutting
the radius to 6px left the gate at 0 of 35. A near miss is dispatched on the `<svg>` now,
and the same break takes it to 33 of 35. **A gate that has never been shown to go red is a
gate nobody has tested — and one shown to go red on the wrong axis is worse.**

**⭐ AND AN ALGEBRAIC IDENTITY IS NOT A FLOATING-POINT ONE.** `setPaperSize` multiplies `w`
by the scale and hands `setSize` `w / scale`; the emitter wrote `wRaw`, with a comment
saying the two cancel. They cancel in real arithmetic. `(x * 0.75) / 0.75` is not `x`, and
applying that round trip to OUR value reproduced abcjs's byte for byte **in both
directions**. One expression: print 7 → 5, `scale 0.8` 4 → 1, `oneSvgPerLine + scale 0.8`
4 → 1. The row that declared "a non-unit scale, geometry inside the SVG" was mostly this.

## 🔬 WHAT LANDED

**THE THREE WRAPPER OPTIONS** — `oneSvgPerLine`, `viewportHorizontal`, `viewportVertical`,
all unimplemented, all 0 of 685. Three rules that no reading predicts: a wrapper's `style`
is a CONCATENATED string and survives `setAttribute` verbatim (`overflow: hidden;height:
55.40625px;` — setting the properties instead normalises it, 86 of 87); the wrapper's
height is scaled and the `<svg>`'s is not; and a section's height INCLUDES the gap above
it, so the divs tile with no seams.

**PACKAGE METADATA — AND THE `bin` ENTRY DID NOT WORK.** `src/cli.ts` had no shebang, npm
marks a `bin` file executable on install, and the shell then ran `dist/cli.js`: its first
line, `import { render } from …`, invoked **ImageMagick's `import`** and took a screenshot.
`version` is `0.1.0` with `repository`/`homepage`/`bugs`/`unpkg`/`jsdelivr`/keywords, and
**the npm name `abcts` is FREE** — the registry 404s.

**THE INTERACTIVE SURFACE.** `setupSelection` (424 lines) was unported outright, so abcts
attached NO DOM event listeners at all and `clickListener` was never called —
`ABCJS.Editor`'s score-to-caret direction was dead. `staffPos` is threaded from the emitter
and `engraver.svgs` with it. The rules worth carrying:

- ⚠️ **`selectable="false"` IS A TRUTHY STRING** and `getTarget` stops on it, so a default
  render is fully clickable. As a boolean, the common case is dead.
- ⚠️ **THE HIGHLIGHT COMES BEFORE THE NOTIFY**, so the `classes` a host receives already
  contains `abcjs-note_selected` — the only class a no-`add_classes` render has.
- ⚠️ **`abcjs-dragging-in-progress` IS ADDED AND NEVER REMOVED**, with a leading space: add
  reads `renderer.paper` and remove reads `renderer.svg`. Reproduced, and named.
- ⚠️ **A TEMPO IS SELECTABLE AND NEVER PAINTED** — `isTempo` is alone in not pushing its
  group into `elemset`. **The rule was already in this repo**, in `range-highlight.ts`,
  with a doc block explaining it. A rule ported at the site that named it is not ported.

**AND THE CLICK GATE FOUND A PARSER DEFECT NO MARKUP GATE COULD SEE**, because a click
hands the host the `abcelem` ITSELF. **An open slur not followed by a note orphans
everything written before it**: `"C"({ge}CD)` opens at the `{` in abcjs and opened at the
`"` here. Twelve rungs; ten already agreed, which is why nothing had named it. The rule was
half-implemented and could only fire when the element OPENED on the run.

## ⚠️ WHAT IS OPEN

1. **THE INTERACTIVE SURFACE'S ONE DECLARED FIXTURE IS A LAYOUT DIFFERENCE.**
   `abcts-ledger-gaps-3-tune3` reports `staffPos.top` 155.45 / `height` 60.932 against
   abcjs's 142.757 / 73.625 — **`zero` is EXACT and `top + height` is EXACT**, so the staff
   origin and the group's bottom both agree and only the SPLIT is ours. The 12.693px is the
   inter-system separation CLAMP: abcjs folds it into `staff.top`, which `startY` is
   measured back from; our layout spends it in the system advance, so `originPitch` is
   13.724 where abcjs's `staff.top` is 17. It moves no ink.
2. **`style=` BETWEEN VOICES — RE-MEASURED, AND IT IS STRANGER THAN THE MARKER SAID.**
   Five rungs, reading each notehead's path length (a slash is ~33-57 characters, a round
   head ~377-389):

       header `K:C style=rhythm`       BOTH voices rhythm, from the first note
       v1 line-start `[K:C style=…]`   v1's OWN notes stay round; v2's are rhythm
       v2 line-start `[K:C style=…]`   NOTHING on that line changes at all
       …and a second line              every voice of it is rhythm, v1 included
       v1 line-start + mid-bar normal  all eight round — the cancel wins first

   `this.style` is engraver state; `pushCrossLineElems` saves slurs, ties, endings,
   `voiceScale` and `voiceColor` and **not it**, and `reset()` does not clear it. **A
   line-start `[K:]` does not reach its own voice's notes** — `appendStartingElement` puts
   it on the STAFF — and then it applies to every later voice and line. A per-voice model
   cannot express any of the three. **The size STANDS**, re-derived twice.
3. **A second `%%voicescale` mid-tune** (`zzledger` KNOWN).
4. **The five remaining `print` rows have FIVE causes**, not one: `visual-options-01-fonts`
   (a `%%text` y 23.54px out, several open causes at once), two `-score-t-b` stem ys that
   round to `202.75` against `202.76`, a `svg-per-line-02-scaled` path x, and one input sum

5. **`scale 0.8` 1 and `scale 1.5` 2** — a jazzchord box on a whole-pixel boundary (93

6. **`[B-eg-b-]|[Begb]|`'s tie y — 60.54 against 60.53.** Pre-dates everything recent.

## TRAPS

- ⚠️ **A DELIBERATE BREAK CAN MISS THE CODE IT WAS AIMED AT.** Check WHICH rows stay green,
  and if a break changes nothing, suspect the probe before the port.
- ⚠️ **AN ALGEBRAIC IDENTITY IS NOT A FLOATING-POINT ONE.** `(x * s) / s`, `x * STEP / STEP`,
  `(w - 2m) + 2m`. This repo has now been bitten by all three.
- ⚠️ **A SHARED FIRST-THREE IS NOT A SHARED SET.** `oneSvgPerLine + scale 0.8` printed the
  same three slugs as `scale 0.8`; the full sets were differenced before it was declared —
  and the SECOND time, on `zzclick`, the two fixtures looked alike and had DIFFERENT causes.
  One was `staffPos`, the other a `startChar`. Differencing is what told them apart.
- ⚠️ **`selectable="false"` IS TRUTHY.** So is `"0"` and every other non-empty string.
- ⚠️ A REPO TEST CAN ASSERT THE DEFECT; A GATE CAN NORMALISE IT AWAY; A SAMPLE IS A LOWER
  BOUND; A FLOOR ROTS. All four still hold.
- ⚠️ `/tmp` is cleaned mid-session. The suite times out under load and it is not a defect.
